 WDTN Dayton Follow Date change announced for Dayton Holiday Festival
 Trey Brown Thu, October 22, 2026 at 9:27 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The Dayton Holiday Festival is changing dates this year.
 Grande Illumination, the annual family-friendly festival is expected to happen on Friday, Dec. 4 from 5 to 8 p.m.
 In years past, it was held the day after Thanksgiving.
 The event was started by Virginia Kettering in 1972 as a way for all children to enjoy the holiday season. The philanthropist believed that the season should be enjoyed no matter one's economic means.
